title: Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory
abstract: arXiv:2604.09320v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mechanistic understanding and rational design of complex chemical systems depend on fast and accurate predictions of electronic structures beyond individual building blocks. However, if the system exceeds hundreds of atoms, first-principles quantum mechanical (QM) modeling becomes impractical. Specifically, we divided the entire system into basic building blocks (fragments), evaluated their one-fragment energies using a QM model, and addressed many-fragment interactions using the structure-property relationships trained by FB-GNNs. translated_title: 可迁移的FB-GNN-MBE框架用于势能面：深度学习的多体展开理论中的数据自适应迁移学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2604.09320v5 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：对复杂化学系统的机理理解和理性设计依赖于对超越单个构建块电子结构的快速且准确预测。然而，如果系统超过数百个原子，第一性原理量子力学（QM）建模变得不切实际。在本研究中，我们通过将基于片段的图神经网络（FB-GNN）集成到多体展开（MBE）理论中，开发了FB-GNN-MBE，并展示了其在可管理的精度、复杂性和可解释性下，再现分层结构系统的第一性原理势能面（PES）的能力。具体来说，我们将整个系统划分为基本构建块（片段），使用QM模型评估其单片段能量，并使用FB-GNN训练的结构-性质关系处理多片段相互作用。我们的研究表明，FB-GNN-MBE在该领域达到了化学精度。
tldr: 本文提出了FB-GNN-MBE框架，通过将片段图神经网络与多体展开理论结合，实现了对复杂化学系统势能面的高效准确预测，达到了化学精度，并支持数据自适应迁移学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the FB-GNN-MBE framework, integrating fragment-based graph neural networks with many-body expansion theory to efficiently and accurately predict potential energy surfaces of complex chemical systems, achieving chemical accuracy and enabling data-adaptive transfer learning.
